This refresher is a bridge into the cube curriculum, not a complete beginner unit.

## Race

The race is about efficient checkers, wastage, and timing. Cube decisions often become clearer because contact threats are reduced.

## Holding Game

A holding game preserves contact from an advanced anchor. Cube timing depends on racing lead, shot equity, and the strength of the anchor.

## Prime

A prime tries to trap opposing checkers behind connected points. Gammons and market losers can appear quickly when the trapped checkers cannot escape.

## Blitz

A blitz attacks loose checkers and aims to close points while the opponent is on the bar. Cube timing can become volatile because gammons matter.

## Backgame

A backgame keeps deep anchors and waits for late shots. Cube action depends heavily on timing, containment, and whether the defender still has a real game.
